- Was called upon by a connection (Caelis Dorn) to contribute to the investigation of The Pilgrim and the murder.
- Antiquities dealer (heirlooms, lost items, oddities)
- "Business contacts" with Vernon Sphinx (Lotor's son) who is known to deal in similar artifacts as Ira.

### Motivation and Goals

 - [ ]  Find the Pilgrim
 - [ ]  Successfully engage in vices (winning at gambling, etc.) six times
 - [ ]  Reconnect with Vernon Sphinx
 - [ ]  Learn Abyssal (10 weeks)
 - [ ]  Pickpocket 10 people
